text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky is training hard for the upcoming Tenno Sho in the fall.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later, a press conference is held for the Umamusume who will run in the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Among them is Special Week, who has always watched Maruzensky from a distance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Finally able to challenge one another in the greatest of arenas, Maruzensky smiles with unconcealed joy.
